lines.en: Low to the ground, I push through ferns.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很大，落地无声。
lines.en: Big feet. Silent landings.

lines.zh: 我沿着围栏走，闻着气味。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, reading scents.
Neck out, I scan the ground.
I trail at the back of the pack.
I go around the mud pit.
My tail balances each step.
I step into the tall grass.

lines.zh: 泥地上，我的爪子留三趾。
lines.en: Three-toed prints in the mud.
I head toward the call.
I walk, then stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，为了隐藏。
lines.en: Shallow breath to stay hidden.

lines.zh: 从这片阴影走到下一片。
lines.en: From one patch of shade to the next.

lines.zh: 我擦过灌木，叶子晃了一下。
lines.en: I brush a bush; leaves tremble.
In the tall grass, only my head shows.

lines.zh: 我在听围栏那边的声音。
lines.en: I listen past the fence.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着会动的东西。
lines.en: My eyes follow anything that moves.
I open my jaws to cool.

lines.zh: 草地上有我的气味标记。
lines.en: My scent marks the grass.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，很难发现。
lines.en: Still, I am hard to spot.
I count the shapes in the distance.
The wind comes from there. I smell it.
I curl my toes, ready to rise.

lines.zh: 我咬着一段骨头，慢慢磨。
lines.en: I gnaw an old bone.
Shade covers my back.
I lift my head to the sky.
I have crossed this ground often.

lines.zh: 群里的叫声，我能分出远近。
lines.en: I can tell how far each call is.
My pupils narrow, fixed on you.
Do not run. Running makes it easy.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，我从下风处闻到。
lines.en: I smell your sweat from downwind.
On that side, you are alone.
I turn slowly. Not from fear.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted what you hold.
My teeth are longer than your fingers.
Big head tilted, perfectly still.
I am in this grass.
I heard you through the brush.

lines.zh: 我抬头的时候，你要小心。
lines.en: When I raise my head, be careful.

lines.zh: 你比我高，但站得没我稳。
lines.en: Taller, but worse planted.
I growl and back into the grass.
A shallow cut in my hide.
I know your scent now.
I shake my head; blood flies.
A limp, but I can still run.
I do not call. It draws others.
That made me warier.
Two steps back, body low.
The wound seeps. No matter.
We are not finished.
Meat? Toss it. Do not hand it over.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很大，落地却没有声。
lines.en: My feet are broad, yet they land silently.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸，牙齿就到你手边。
lines.en: One stretch of my neck and my teeth reach your hand.
That one still has bone.
Three steps back, then I come.
Not one mouthful.
Only raw meat makes me open my jaws.
Keep your hand out.
I stare at the meat in your hand.
A sniff first, then I hunt my own.
My breastbone numbs your arm.
I sidestep, then turn back.

lines.zh: 粗尾巴把你绊了个趔趄。
lines.en: My thick tail trips you off balance.
You push; I give a step.
My hide is coarse.

lines.zh: 碰撞让它看见了我的位置。
lines.en: The bump showed it where I am.
I growl and back into the grass.
Three toes dig into the mud.
Utah's tyrannosaur, used to hunting in groups.
I stand still, blocking your path.
We might hunt in packs.

lines.zh: 这问题，我不在草地上答。
lines.en: Not answering that on open ground.
Between us, scent matters most.
Stop. You stand too close.

lines.zh: 我们争夺地盘，不争夺别的。
lines.en: We fight over ground, nothing else.
I roar into the deep woods.
Pack ties are complicated.

lines.zh: 你把背对着我，很不明智。
lines.en: Turning your back is unwise.

lines.zh: 换个话题，问我吃不吃你。
lines.en: Ask something else. Like whether I eat you.

lines.zh: 我走开了，这个话题结束。
lines.en: I walk off. Topic closed.
I take the bone in my jaws.
The meat you dropped is mine.
I pin the meat with a claw.
I lick the blood off the ground.
I drag it two steps with my jaws and drop it.
I drag it into the brush.
I snap your arrow underfoot.
Too small to bother with.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看有没有人来抢。
lines.en: I check for rivals.
You take it. I will not contest.

lines.zh: 犹他的暴龙科，群起而攻。
lines.en: Utah's tyrannosaur hunts in groups.

lines.zh: 你身上没有同伴的气味。
lines.en: No pack scent on you.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低沉的响声。
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in my throat.
I aim this bite at a leg.
More movement in the grass.

lines.zh: 你退向围栏，是错的选择。
lines.en: Retreating to the fence is a mistake.
I mark your back.
There are two more behind me.
First a call, then the move.
This time I am not alone.

lines.zh: 你听见后面的脚步了吗？
lines.en: Hear the steps behind you?
We are closing the circle.
You have one way out.
Now I run.
I come in along the grass tips.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，草就动一下。
lines.en: Each step back stirs the grass.
I am at your rear flank.
My claws rake the dirt again and again.
You are watching the wrong way.
The wind scatters my scent.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我数到第四下。
lines.en: Your footsteps. I counted four.
Stopping in the open is bad.
Not biting yet. First the circle.
The grass leans one way.

lines.zh: 你的护甲有一处没盖住。
lines.en: One spot your armor misses.
Last three steps. I speed up.
The calls stopped. That is the signal.
Soft ground slows you.
Now I strike.
One toss of my head and you're on the ground.
The hit brings you down.
My claws pin your shoulder.
Bite, withdraw, come again.
Deep wound. Fast blood.
You stopped the teeth, not the charge.

lines.zh: 牙齿一合，咬进你的肩甲。
lines.en: My jaws close on your pauldron.
That one carried my whole weight.
You retreat. Blood on the grass.

lines.zh: 我又抬起头，看你还在不在。
lines.en: I lift my head to see if you remain.
My tail balances the blow.
That bite only tore cloth.
Quick reactions.
Your bracer is still in my mouth.
A shape in the tall grass.

lines.zh: 围栏那边传来一声低吼。
lines.en: A growl past the fence.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里站起来，族群在身后。
lines.en: I rise from the ferns; my kin are behind me.
Three-toed prints in the mud.
My big head emerges from the tree shadow.
Very light footsteps.
Pack calls rise in the distance.
Those three-toed prints are mine.
A shadow shifts from behind a tree.
One more in the enclosure.
My head shows first.
Mud pressed down by a foot.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我已经到了。
lines.en: I am there when you look back.
A new scent on the wind.
I come through a gap in the fence.
The grass goes quiet but for me.
I crouch and wait.

lines.zh: 现在，这里有两个捕食者。
lines.en: Now there are two hunters here.
Fire on my back; I spin.

lines.zh: 我从岩坡滚下，摔进了泥。
lines.en: I tumble down a slope into mud.
My heavy body sinks, legs kicking wildly.

lines.zh: 犹他的草太干，火一起来就烧。
lines.en: Utah grass is dry; fire spreads fast.
A dart sticks in my neck.

lines.zh: 犹他的暴龙科，可能成群捕猎。
lines.en: A Utah tyrannosaur; perhaps a pack hunter.

lines.zh: 没吃到东西，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: No kills and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的牙显得很白。
lines.en: In lightning, my teeth look white.
The ground is gone.
